Ari: FYI I ran a 4h sweep of micro-batch interval + coalesce jitter against release/edge. Repro: p95 tail appears when jitter ~1.5ms and coalesce_delay < 3ms. Attached summary below — small but repeatable latency spikes and a KV hit-rate dip.

Kevin: Is this the same KV-priming regression from yesterday's canary?

Ari: Related symptom but different trigger. CPU/GPU profile shows kernel-selection flip-flop: when micro-batches are tiny & frequent we see the kernel selector alternate between fp16-opt and int8 paths, which increases L2/DRAM churn and seems to cause KV eviction thrash. KV hit rate drops ~7% during spikes, which cascades into more small batches.

Maria: ugh kernel thrash + KV eviction = bad locality. Can you paste the kernel selection histogram and the KV hit timeline?

Ari: sure — summary snippet:

```
# kernel_sel_histogram (counts over sweep window)
fp16-opt:  3121
int8-fast: 2987
int8-slow:  412
fallback:   29
switch_rate_per_sec: 5.8
avg_batch_size_tokens:  46
kv_hit_rate: 0.87 -> 0.80 during spikes
```

Also observed: token_budget target 128 produced many sub-100-token microbatches under the heavy arrival variance.

PerfBot: automated-run-2412345678-run1: baseline p50=28ms p95=210ms p99=420ms kv_hit=0.87 jitter=1.5ms coalesce_delay=2ms avg_batch_tokens=46

OpsBot: Canary at 21:12 UTC picked up the microwindow tweak; rollback executed at 21:18 UTC due to increased p95 alerts.

Kevin: Proposal: raise jitter floor to 4ms and coalesce_delay to 6ms for queues with high arrival variance. Add a short kernel-affinity hysteresis (sticky window ~50ms) in selector to avoid flip-flop after small batches. Also nudge token_budget target up to 192 so batches have more tokens to amortize kernel switch cost.

Maria: +1 for the sticky kernel affinity and larger token budget. Also recommend adding a KV priming probe: if kv_hit falls by >3% in a 10s window, temporarily increase coalesce_delay by 2x for that queue to let cache warm. We'll need to monitor cost impact.

Ari: I'll run an A/B with those params (jitter=4ms, coalesce=6ms, token_budget=192, kernel_hysteresis=50ms). Scheduling now; will post perf diffs tomorrow. Pausing rollout until results are in. :thumbsup:

Kevin: If the A/B looks good, let's stage the policies behind a rollout flag and enable for 10% traffic first. Keep alerts on p95 and kv_hit.

Maria: Added notes to the runtime experiment tracker.

Ari: Thanks — I'll attach the full flame graphs & CSV in the follow-up thread.
